request: Restrict beyond-first-year repeat-diagnosis analysis to people with more than three months of available follow-up
operational_threshold: Strictly more than 90 observable days after the first calendar anniversary of discharge (91 or more days). This is an approximate three-month cutoff, not three calendar months.
base_cohort: Original 175505 matched-pair pregnancy-group women with 2023 delivery admissions, same early-first cohorts
first_record: First primary record before 20 weeks after original history and own pre-index exclusions
start: Day after first calendar anniversary of delivery-hospitalization discharge
eligibility: More than 90 available observation days and continuous recorded medical enrollment from discharge through 2024-12-31; commercial or managed Medicaid at delivery discharge
outcome: Any repeat primary-definition diagnosis in any setting throughout each woman's entire available period after the first discharge anniversary; no evaluation, medication, or procedure requirement
uncertainty: Wilson pointwise 95% intervals; descriptive independent Newcombe payer contrasts, not adjusted for follow-up duration or confounding
interpretation: Excludes very short follow-up but still compares unequal observation periods; repeat documentation does not establish treatment
